reason: The hypothesis applies the well-known γ′ precipitation strengthening mechanism, extensively studied in Ni-based superalloys and Ni-Co-Fe-Cr-Al-Ti HEAs (P1, P3, P19), to a new Ti-Ni primary HEA composition. However, it does not provide a specific reason why this mechanism would transfer successfully to a matrix where Ti and Ni are both primary constituents, nor does it address the phase stability or precipitate morphology challenges unique to such a system. The proposal is essentially a direct extrapolation of existing results to a new composition without new mechanistic insight or integration of conflicting evidence.
